$comment: The subset builds (arch.layers.13, gragas#341): each part that must stay separable, the build that proves it, and what that build must never link. The Go subset is held by internal/subset_test.go, which go list -deps reads, and the TypeScript subsets by explorer/test/subset-builds.test.ts, which builds each package with the compiler. A forbidden entry is a package (Go: an import path from the module; TypeScript: a package name, or @gragas/* for every sibling), and the output of a TypeScript build is also searched for each entry, and for each of its markers (text such as the module path of the here view, explorer-iframe-build-entry), as text. The pre-push and release tiers run both. A subset names the decision it stands on, and so does each package let past a check (allowed). gragas-dev gate holds this file to gate/schema/subsets.schema.json, each decision to a record docs/reasons lists by that exact name, and the list to the base's (a base with no list is a report line): it only shrinks, and a row that lets more in (another build, entry or package, a forbidden entry or a marker dropped, no_embeds turned off, a package allowed) stands on a decision record the base does not hold.

subsets.name: gragas-subset
subsets.why: the engine without the explorer: the command tree with the Assets port answering unavailable, so no embedded file of the explorer is linked

allowed.why: the commands decided and not built, kept as YAML files the package embeds: they are the command list, not the explorer's files
the settings help table's rows that name a system's variables are one data file the package embeds, so no Go file names a system: the engine's own table, not the explorer's files

subsets.name: element
subsets.why: the web component is built without the standalone package, so no here view and no shell travel with it

subsets.name: plugin-docs
subsets.why: the docs plugin wraps the element and is built without the standalone package

subsets.name: plugin-portal
subsets.why: the portal plugin wraps the element and is built without the standalone package

subsets.name: contract
subsets.why: the contract is the leaf every other package imports: it builds and its tests run with every sibling unresolvable (ts.modules.5, arch.layers.7)
